name: Prism
_todo: int8 and the bf16 add-on are published at Hugging Face revision 9b15eef and ModelScope (modelscope.ai) OpenVDN/Prism-FreeVideo-Preview commit 138cfa6. fp8 is not built or published; it stays a manual, unpublished variant.
layout: Each variant folder is self-contained (prism_prepare output, the FreeVideo prepared format): manifest.json (bytes + sha256 of every file), root.safetensors, expert_high|expert_low/blocks/NN.safetensors (base Prism weights, quantized), lora_high|lora_low/{root,blocks/NN}.safetensors (Lightx2v 260412 distill LoRA, bf16, unmerged), audio/blocks/NN.safetensors, bridge/NN.safetensors, configs/, text_encoder/ (UMT5-XXL bf16), tokenizer/, vae/ (Wan2.1), audio_vae/ (DAC). The engine takes the install root (it picks the variant folder for the GPU) or a variant folder.

modelscope._note: modelscope.ai commit with the same content as the Hugging Face revision; all 392 rows verified (size and SHA-256) on 2026-10-06.

_auto_variants: Variants setup may pick for a GPU, in order of preference (the first the GPU supports). To ship INT8 (had128) for every GPU, set ["int8"]: fp8 stays a manual choice.

bf16.label: BF16 weights for the Original level
bf16.requires: int8 or fp8 (text encoder, tokenizer and VAEs are read from that folder)
bf16.note: Original (the official 50-step recipe) runs these unquantized weights with the exact bf16 attention kernel; without them it uses the int8/fp8 weights with Sage attention.
